notes.title: Blackwind Patch 1.0.2.6
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your continued support and for continuing to report issues to our team!

In this patch we have fixed crashing instances which were caused by the addition of a new drone tutorial. 

As always, please report any issues to our team at support@blowfishstudios.com 
We read everything sent our way :)

notes.title: Blackwind Patch 1.0.2.5 (Mac)
notes.content:
Hello Again Battleframe Pilots!

As promised, we have now rolled out the latest patch to all Mac users as well! Detailed updates can be found in the previous post. 

Thank you for the continued support!
As always, please report any issues to our team at support@blowfishstudios.com

notes.title: Blackwind Patch 1.0.2.5
notes.content:
Hello Battleframe Pilots! 

We are pushing more updates as we continue to improve the gameplay experience. This patch addresses the following issues:

[list]
[*]Removal of more dialogue lines that may sound annoying to some people.
[*]Fixed an issue where the power icon was disappearing in certain occasions.
[*]Custom resolution settings now correctly restores when reloading the game.
[*]Added a small tutorial for the ability to teleport the drone when it is too far from the player to re-join.
[*]Fixed some minimap details. 
[/list]

Unfortunately, this patch is only available for players currently on Windows. We are working on rolling out these updates for Mac users soon!

notes.title: Blackwind Hotfix 1.0.2.2
notes.content:
Fixed a small graphical issue appearing only in Windows builds.

Hope you've all been enjoying the latest updates!

Please continue to report any issues to our team support@blowfishstudios.com.

notes.title: Blackwind Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
[i]Blackwind Protocol: Updating… Updating… Updated.

Blackwind Patch 1.0.2 … 

… Released.[/i]

[b]Attention Battleframe Pilots![/b]

We want to, firstly, thoroughly thank everyone who provided our team with feedback on the Blackwind release! The development team has been working incredibly hard to resolve the community’s concerns promptly, and we are proud to announce that we have delivered the first patch for Blackwind!

The focus for this patch was for quick turnaround with the key presented issues, and so you can now expect…
1) Adjusted the camera positioning to improve gameplay.
2) Reduced repetitive one liner voice overs.
3) Provided a mini-map for outdoor environments.
4) Resolved crashes at certain checkpoints.
5) Added the ability to teleport the drone back to the player when it's too far to re-join.

Please continue to report any issues to our team support@blowfishstudios.com. 

Wish you luck!

notes.title: Blackwind Arriving on Jan 20th!
notes.content:
Greetings, Pilots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853999/3b3425ccfdb9556522fa44f44a68d538a0fd3c6d.gif[/img]

We’re happy to announce that Blackwind is arriving to [b]PC[/b] via [b]Steam[/b] and [b]GOG[/b], and the [b]Mac App Store[/b], as well as [b]PlayStation 5[/b], [b]Xbox Series X|S[/b], [b]PlayStation 4[/b], [b]Xbox One[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b], on [u][b]Thursday, January 20th[/b][/u]!

Physical versions lock-on to retail shelves courtesy of [b]Perp Games[/b] on Friday Jan. 21, 2022 in European regions with North American copies arriving at a later date.

Blackwind is a top-down sci-fi action game that puts you in the shoes of a teenager trapped inside a prototype battle armor suit during an alien invasion. Face off against enemies, cut through their ranks, and fight back in a last-ditch attempt to stop a planetary invasion.

You can watch the date announcement trailer here:

[previewyoutube=KgxldOchBno;full][/previewyoutube]

And make sure to wishlist the game here so you can get it as soon as it launches!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567520/Blackwind/
